changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]Posters with badges[/COLOR]
-New in Settings, under poster rotation: Posters with badges. Movie and TV show posters, in luc_kodi's lists and in its Home rows, carry badges drawn on the poster itself, so they show in any skin.
-At the top, one ribbon in the poster's own colour: a Top 20 place, an award or nomination, IMDb Top 250, a new release or a finished series. Genre and year are optional and off by default.
-Extra option, off by default: at the bottom, the picture and sound of a real release: Dolby Vision / HDR10+ / HDR10 / HDR and Dolby Atmos / DTS:X / DTS-HD MA / DTS-HD / DTS, drawn by your server. They come from the release you played of that title or, if none, from the best release found by its last source search (kept 30 days), and picture and sound always come from the same release. For TV shows, an episode sets the badges of the show poster. Turn them on in Settings once your server draws them.
-The title is never lost or blurred: a poster without text is only used together with the title logo, placed by the badge server; otherwise the poster with its printed title is used as it is. No rating is drawn on the poster.
-The badges are drawn by your own SpatialPosters server (free and open source): write its address in Settings and use Test badge server to check it. luc_kodi never uses a public server and never sends any of your keys to it. The bottom badges are for advanced users who add them to their own server; a server without them simply ignores them, and the help explains what luc_kodi asks for.
-Fast: luc_kodi sends posters and logos at the 500 x 750 size the server draws, its service asks the server for a whole page of posters as soon as it is built, and badges are refreshed once a week, so after the first visit of the week a list shows at once.
-Help in Settings explains all of it.
